name: Angelo Prime

palette.eyeColor: natural eye colour from the reference image, clarified and gently enhanced with crisp definition - do not recolour
palette.eyeColorGlamour: natural eye colour from the reference image, clarified and gently enhanced with crisp definition - do not recolour
palette.hairColor: natural hair colour from the reference image, lightly enhanced with healthy shine and dimension - do not recolour
palette.skinTone: natural skin tone from the reference image, evenly toned and lightly enhanced - do not alter undertone

physique.chest: Defined, naturally muscular chest and core, toned and healthy, not exaggerated

notes: Calibration test-bed hero — NOT part of any real card series (group: angel-primes). Eyes/hair/skin are deliberately adaptive wording (enhance the reference photo's own likeness rather than impose a fixed look), with empty eye/skin negative lists, so this hero validates pose/hair/motion prompt changes against any arbitrary input photo. Physique stays a fixed description, same convention as the Drakn sisters. Palette (Soft Pearl White / Warm Champagne Gold / Dove Grey) is a fixed, generic 'angel' wardrobe scheme governing only the test outfit, not the subject's natural colouring. First male hero in the art pipeline — introduced pose-male-human.txt and the male physique (build/chest/waist/legs) branch in gen_prompt.py's tokens_for().
